desc: Redraw this water drop snail as a detailed 16-bit indie game sprite: realistic snail proportions, same face, mint spiral shell with a blue water drop on top, pale green body, small plain eyes, same pose and silhouette. Muted natural palette, thin dark navy outline, 3-4 shade steps with pixel clusters, deeper shadows under head and belly, highlights on shell and drop, subtle shell shading. No gradients, no ground shadow.
